name: Gimbaldrop
description: Raise the flail over the shoulder and bring the head down on the target in one chopping arc.

name: Hard Chainlink
description: Snap the wrist so the head jumps out on loose chain and stings an opponent at arm's length.

name: Swivel Husk
description: Lift the haft crosswise before the face to take a blow on the wood while the head hangs behind.

name: Swingarm Wedge
description: Pull the chain taut across an incoming stick or arm to turn the strike away from the body.

name: Flailhead Hop
description: Step back one pace while lifting the head off the ground so it never tangles the feet.

name: Descending Wheel
description: Drive the butt of the haft into the belly of a close opponent while the head swings idle.

name: Threshdash
description: Swing the short-chained head from the hip in a low flat arc into the thigh or ribs.

name: Firm Rebound
description: Whirl the head in a small loop beside the body to gather speed before releasing the blow.

name: Swivelcowl
description: Tuck the elbow against the ribs and hold the chain short so a grabbing hand cannot hook the head.

name: Wheellid
description: Haul slack chain back hand over hand so a seized head comes free before it is stripped away.

name: Stepping Spikehead
description: Advance two paces and stop dead so the swinging head arrives as the opponent's weight settles.

name: Headball Hit
description: Flick the head sideways past a raised guard and into the open flank.

name: Low Thresh
description: Rap the iron cap at the haft's end against a wrist to loosen the opponent's grip.

name: Descending Linkband
description: Grip the long haft in both hands and heave the head over the shoulder onto the target.

name: Firm Chainring
description: Slide the rear hand up the haft mid-swing to lengthen the arc and catch an opponent stepping back.

name: Lowered Handstaff
description: Hold the haft level across the chest with both hands to stop a downward cut on the wood.

name: Swivelpause
description: Sweep the haft sideways to bat a thrust off its line while the head trails safely behind.

name: Pulling Hingecap
description: Shove the haft crosswise into the opponent's chest to break his stride and open room for the head.

name: Stiff Lashout
description: Lift the head high and let the chain pay out so it falls like a thresher onto a crouched target.

name: Short Hingecap
description: Whip the head up from below the hip toward the chin or the inside of the elbow.

name: Short Swivel
description: Swing the head across and back in two joined strokes without pausing between them.

name: Threshstrike
description: Let the head carry over the shoulder and roll back down behind it into a second blow.

name: Flailhop
description: Stamp the lead foot as the head begins its fall so the whole weight lands together.

name: Looping Strike
description: Turn the wrist outward and cut the head back across the target on the return swing.

name: Chainlink Cowl
description: Hold the haft arm high with the chain wound once around the wrist to cover the head from above.

name: Skipping Thresh
description: Plant one foot and pivot on its ball to bring the swinging head around to a flanking foe.

name: Square Looping
description: Set the feet wide and low so a heavy cross swing leaves the balance untouched.

name: Sideways Swingthru
description: Slide both feet along the ground after the head to keep pace without crossing the legs.

name: Sideways Lashout
description: Step in a half circle around the opponent so the head always swings into open space.

name: Flailpace
description: Crouch beneath a rival swing and let it pass over the hair before rising to strike.

name: Tight Handstaff
description: Set the heels against the ground and lean into a shoved haft to hold position against a rush.

name: Open Headball
description: Turn the hips ahead of the arms so the head arrives with the whole body's weight behind it.

name: Flailblow
description: Push a thread of qi along the haft so the head lands heavier at the end of an overhead swing.

name: Spare Swingarm
description: Run qi down the chain as the wrist snaps so the head arrives with a sharper sting.

name: Gimbalbump
description: Keep the head circling beside the body through a slow breath count ready to release on any beat.

name: Folded Chainring
description: Settle a little qi into the gripping hand and forearm so the haft holds steady when a blow lands on it.

name: Swivelstay
description: Tighten the chain with a pulse of qi and bat a thrust aside across its length.

name: Backward Rebound
description: Step back on the exhale and let the head swing out ahead as the opponent follows into range.

name: Smooth Spikehead
description: Feel the weight and position of the head through the chain with qi in the fingers and no glance at it.

name: Square Wheel
description: Hold the haft in one hand and swing the head out on the full chain at shoulder height.

name: Quick Thresh
description: Gather chain into the fist to shorten it for a close hit or pay it out for a far one.

name: Turning Swingthru
description: Loop one turn of chain around an opponent's forearm and haul to pin the arm against the body.

name: Gimbalhusk
description: Lift the haft to meet a descending blade and roll it outward off its line.

name: Tight Chainring
description: Let the head drop beside the knee as a counterweight while the haft covers the guard.

name: Skipping Swingthru
description: Slide the lead foot forward as the swing starts and bring the rear foot up behind it.

name: Swivelstrike
description: Sweep the head low along the ground on slack chain to hit the shins of a charging foe.

name: Flailstrike
description: Rap the haft's end cap against a hand or knee when the opponent crowds inside the chain.

name: Angled Spikehead
description: Haul the chain back along its own arc after a miss so the head returns to guard before a counter lands.

name: Linkband Bump
description: Turn a missed downward swing into a rising flick that catches the opponent leaning in to answer.

name: Gimbalwedge
description: Whip the haft in a tight circle so a rival blade snarled in the chain slides loose.

name: Kept Headball
description: Pluck the swinging head from the air with a cloth-wrapped off hand to stop it dead.

name: Swingarm Bump
description: Let a low head strike the ground and rebound upward into the opponent's knee.

name: Calm Flailhead
description: Return to a ready stance while one slow breath checks that the head and chain hang true.

name: Wheelhit
description: Swing the head across at chest height in the wide flat stroke used to beat grain on a floor.

name: Kept Flailhead
description: Hold the haft braced like a barn bar against a shoulder charge driving in at the chest.

name: Quick Swivel
description: Walk with the head swinging loose in time with the stride then fling it at a sudden target.

name: Narrow Chainlink
description: Keep the chain short and the swing upright to strike in a packed lane without hitting neighbours.

name: Gimbalhop
description: Take short wide flat-footed steps that grip soft or wet ground while the head keeps swinging.

name: Threshlid
description: Hook the chain behind an opponent's calf and pull to drop him to one knee.

name: Downward Hingecap
description: Smash the head down on the opponent's guard hand where it grips a staff or fence rail.

name: Flaildash
description: Draw breath as the head rises and release it with the downward blow so the strike lands on the exhale.

name: Wheelstrike
description: Hold a smooth orbit of the head through one long exhale and let it go at the breath's end.

name: Planted Handstaff
description: Hold the breath and set the stance at the instant of impact so a blow on the haft cannot stagger the body.

name: Sideways Looping
description: Count steps against swings so the head and feet fall into one steady cadence.

name: Deep Spikehead
description: Read the opponent's weight shift through the chain's tension and time a swing to the lean.
